label: FICTION. Camera demo only. Do not publish as history or as a true story.
prop: a single knife-notch in the heel of a loaf
line: The town taxed bread by the cut slice. A notch was how a loaf admitted it had been opened. A second notch dried a different color, and that color was the lie.

shots.focus: the pale notch in the crust
shots.action: The notch fills the frame, then the loaf eases back onto a floured board.
Oven, bench, and a waiting crate open up behind one loaf.
The baker steps in. Camera rises from floury shoes to the face.
A flour sack in the foreground crosses as the line names the tax.
Sliced bread is taxed. A whole loaf is not.

shots.focus: knife and the heel of the loaf
shots.action: One notch, cut, and the hand stops.
The crumb at the notch is still soft.
An honest loaf is one notch. Said too early, on purpose.
The peel crosses frame. Every loaf on it carries a single notch.

shots.focus: rack from the doorpost to the stall
shots.action: Through the shop door into the morning market.
A post crosses. One loaf has one notch. The next has two.
A buyer treats the second notch as a baker's mark, not a lie.
Someone adds a second notch at the stall. The camera stops on the cut.
The new cut is pale. The older one has dried darker.

shots.focus: a watching face behind a loaf
shots.action: A loaf in front clears off a face that has already understood.
They don't speak. The color is the evidence.

shots.focus: boots in market mud, then the face
shots.action: The watcher stands. We rise with them.
The loaf is the accusation. No new prop.

shots.focus: rack from a doorframe to a table
shots.action: Into the guild room. Same morning, harder light.
A top-down ledger tilts into a room with the loaf on it.
The count is by the slice. The page has no column for color.

shots.focus: baker on one side, inspector on the other
shots.action: The table edge crosses as we slide from one seat to the other.
The loaf lands. Camera velocity dies on the thud.
Eight blur frames from inspector to baker. Same room.
The baker says nothing. The loaf stays in frame.
Twenty-two degrees around the loaf. No face on the far side of the turn.

shots.focus: a finger on the darker notch
shots.action: A finger finds the dried cut and stops.
Third and last punch. The lie is a color, not a shape.
The rule finally fits the object.

shots.focus: the notch, revealed past a ledger
shots.action: The standing ledger slides off the heel of the loaf.
Hold the explanation. Do not add a fact.

shots.focus: one loaf, then the oven behind it
shots.action: Back in the bakery. The notch stays low in frame while the oven returns.
Almost still. One notch. No new fact.
